name: agentic/testimonials
title: Testimonials
description: Customer quotes with attribution — a scroll-snap slider of review cards (columns visible on large screens, fewer as the viewport narrows), or set layout:"carousel" for large photo-testimonial cards with a product chip. Each item can add a photoUrl avatar, a 1-5 rating, a platform ("google" | "trustpilot") badge, and a reviewUrl that makes the whole card a new-tab link to the real review.
